title: Viridity's Medium Fantsasy Collection
description: The same as my light fantsasy pack, but for befier pcs!
body:
A somewhat lightweight, performance-focused fantasy modpack built for smooth gameplay—without sacrificing magic, exploration, or atmosphere.

Designed to run well on low-medium end systems, Medium Fantsasy delivers a refined modded Minecraft experience with carefully selected content and heavy optimization.

What This Pack Offers: Magic & Progression Harness powerful spells with Iron’s Spells ‘n Spellbooks and uncover mystical systems through exploration. Enhanced Exploration Discover improved structures from YUNG’s worldgen mods, including dungeons, strongholds, and temples that feel handcrafted and immersive. Quality of Life Improvements Inventory and control enhancements In-game recipe viewing (JEI) Minimap navigation Cleaner UI and better feedback Performance First Design Built with a full suite of modern optimization mods to ensure: Smooth FPS Reduced stuttering Faster loading times

Optimized for low-medium end PCs

This pack is specifically tuned for systems with:

CPUs, like the: AMD Ryzen 9 5900HX with Radeon Graphics
GPUs, like the: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU

Credits:

All mods belong to their respective authors. A full list of mods and credits is included with the pack.
